summary.tldr: Requires certain spectrum licence holders to provide service to at least 50% of the population in their licence area within three years.
what_it_does: Requires holders of licences issued under subparagraph 5(1)(a)(i.1) to deploy the spectrum to provide service to at least 50% of the population in the licence area within three years.
Requires holders using radio frequencies in a Tier 1 to 4 service area to provide service to at least 50% of the population in any Tier 5 service areas inside the licence area within three years.
Requires anyone selling one of these licences within three years to make the service condition part of the sale.
Allows the Minister to revoke a licence for not meeting the service condition, after written notice and a chance to respond.

Requires the Minister to reissue a revoked or surrendered licence through competitive bidding or another reallocation process within 60 days, and bars the revoked holder and its affiliates from that process.
summary.background: The bill adds a new condition for licences issued under subparagraph 5(1)(a)(i.1) of the Radiocommunication Act. It also applies to licences already in force when the bill comes into force.
